verses.english: Taste is the heart of the devotional path.
verses.slovenian: Okus oziroma notranja naklonjenost je srce poti predanosti.

verses.english: Through attentive hearing, that devotional mood gradually becomes stronger.
verses.slovenian: S pozornim poslušanjem se ta notranji odnos postopoma krepi.

verses.english: Hearing and chanting are essential parts of devotional practice.
verses.slovenian: Poslušanje in petje sta bistvena dela predanega duhovnega praktikovanja.

verses.english: Remembrance becomes deeper when joined with service.
verses.slovenian: Spominjanje postaja globlje, ko je povezano s služenjem.
